take.title_zh: WWDC 2026：Apple 打開 AI 選擇權，多模型時代正式宣告
take.title_en: WWDC 2026: Apple Opens Multi-Model AI — The Choice Era Begins
take.body_zh:
Apple 在 WWDC 2026 宣布 iOS 27 的 AI Extensions 框架，讓用戶選擇 Claude、Gemini 或 ChatGPT 作為 Siri 與 Writing Tools 的底層模型。這是移動端 AI 從「封閉標配」走向「開放選配」的關鍵轉折，也意味著設計師必須開始設計「AI 模型不可知」的介面——同一個功能入口，背後可能跑著三種行為特徵截然不同的模型。

同一週，Anthropic 以 $9,650 億估值超越 OpenAI 並秘密申請 IPO；Microsoft 在 Build 大會推出自建推理模型 MAI-Thinking-1，終止對 OpenAI 的依賴。AI 基礎設施競爭已從「誰的 API 最好用」演進到「誰控制模型底層」——設計師若要做出可靠的 AI 體驗決策，需要愈來愈深入地理解各模型的差異與邊界。
take.body_en:
Apple's iOS 27 AI Extensions framework lets users pick Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to power Siri and Writing Tools — shifting mobile AI from locked-in defaults to user-selectable models. For designers, the immediate challenge is consistency: the same interface now routes to three behaviorally distinct models, and maintaining coherent UX across all three requires new design principles.

The same week, Anthropic surpassed OpenAI at a $965B valuation and confidentially filed for an IPO; Microsoft launched MAI-Thinking-1, its first self-built reasoning model, reducing dependency on OpenAI. The AI infrastructure race has evolved from API quality to model ownership. Designers who build fluency with model differences will make sharper AI product decisions.

articles.title_zh: WWDC 2026 全記錄：Siri AI、iOS 27、Multi-AI Extensions 完整整理
articles.title_en: Everything Announced at Apple's WWDC 2026 Keynote
articles.summary_zh: Apple WWDC 2026 主題演講宣布多項重大更新：iOS 27 引入 AI Extensions 框架，允許用戶選擇 Claude、Gemini 或 ChatGPT 作為 Siri 與 Writing Tools 的底層模型；全新 Siri AI 採用 Google Gemini 驅動，從畫面中央下滑即可喚出對話介面；macOS 27 正式命名為 Golden Gate。這是執行長 Tim Cook 主持的最後一屆 WWDC 主題演講，Apple 正式進入 AI 多模型選擇時代。支援裝置為 iPhone 16 系列及 iPhone 15 Pro 以上。
articles.summary_en: Apple's WWDC 2026 keynote introduced iOS 27 with an AI Extensions framework letting users select Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to power Siri and Writing Tools. The redesigned Siri AI runs on Google Gemini and is accessible by swiping down from center screen. macOS 27 is named Golden Gate. Tim Cook delivered his final WWDC keynote as CEO. iOS 27 requires iPhone 16 or iPhone 15 Pro and later.
articles.take_zh: AI Extensions 是 Apple 數年來最重要的 UX 架構決策——首次承認單一 AI 無法滿足所有人，把模型選擇還給用戶。設計師需要開始建立「AI 模型不可知」介面的一致性原則。
articles.take_en: AI Extensions is Apple's most consequential UX architecture move in years — conceding no single AI suits everyone, and giving users the choice. Designers now need principles for model-agnostic interface consistency.

articles.title_zh: WWDC 2026 是 Apple 的 AI 大躍進，但 iOS 27 仍缺一個關鍵功能
articles.title_en: WWDC 2026 Was Apple's AI Renaissance — But iOS 27 Is Still Missing One Key Feature
articles.summary_zh: Tom's Guide 以「AI 文藝復興」定義 WWDC 2026：新 Siri AI、多模型 Extensions 框架、Writing Tools 全面升級，讓 iPhone AI 體驗大步躍進。然而文章指出，iOS 27 仍缺少一項用戶期待已久的重要功能，顯示 Apple 的 AI 策略依舊是有節奏的漸進部署，而非一次全量交付。整體評價：Apple 在 AI 競賽中找回主動權，但差距縮小的工作尚未完成。
articles.summary_en: Tom's Guide labels WWDC 2026 Apple's 'AI renaissance,' citing the new Siri AI, multi-model Extensions, and upgraded Writing Tools as major capability leaps. But the piece flags one long-awaited feature still absent from iOS 27, reinforcing Apple's deliberate phased rollout over a big-bang release. Overall verdict: Apple has reclaimed AI momentum, but the gap-closing work isn't done.
articles.take_zh: Apple 的 AI 策略向來是「穩步前進、寧少勿濫」，WWDC 2026 的亮點夠大，但那個缺席的功能再次提醒我們：Apple 永遠按自己的節奏，不急於一次全給。
articles.take_en: Apple's AI playbook — ship big, hold back one thing — is both its quality advantage and its chronic frustration point. WWDC 2026 fits the pattern: a genuine leap, with one feature still conspicuously absent.

articles.title_zh: Apple 官方：下一代 Apple Intelligence 與 Siri AI 正式發布
articles.title_en: Apple Unveils Next Generation of Apple Intelligence, Siri AI, and More
articles.summary_zh: Apple 官方新聞稿宣布 iOS 27、iPadOS 27 及 macOS 27 的下一代 Apple Intelligence，核心為全新 Siri AI 及支援 Claude、Gemini、ChatGPT 三選一的 Extensions 框架，Writing Tools 與 Image Playground 均可由用戶所選模型驅動。官方特別強調：無論選擇哪個 AI 模型，Apple 的隱私保護機制一律適用，不因模型來源不同而有差異。支援裝置含 iPhone 16 系列、iPhone 15 Pro、M1 以上 iPad 及 Mac。
articles.summary_en: Apple's official announcement details next-generation Apple Intelligence across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27, centered on a new Siri AI and the Extensions framework supporting Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT. Writing Tools and Image Playground are model-selectable. Apple explicitly states its privacy protections apply consistently regardless of which AI model the user chooses. Supported devices include iPhone 16, iPhone 15 Pro, and M1-and-later iPad and Mac.
articles.take_zh: 官方文件明確保證「隱私保護不因 AI 模型選擇改變」，這是 Apple 多模型架構的核心信任設計——用戶選哪個 AI 是自由，但 Apple 的隱私承諾是不變的底線。
articles.take_en: Apple's explicit privacy guarantee regardless of AI model choice is the trust architecture underpinning Extensions — users pick the AI, but Apple owns the privacy contract. That's a meaningful competitive moat.

articles.title_zh: Anthropic 以 $9,650 億估值超越 OpenAI，秘密申請 IPO
articles.title_en: Anthropic Surpasses OpenAI at $965B Valuation, Confidentially Files for IPO
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布完成新一輪融資，估值達到 9,650 億美元，正式超越 OpenAI，成為全球估值最高的 AI 公司。同時，Anthropic 向 SEC 秘密申請 IPO，具體掛牌時程尚未公開。這輪估值躍升主要由 Claude Code 在 AI 程式碼輔助市場的主導地位所驅動，標誌著 Anthropic 從安全導向的 AI 研究機構正式蛻變為深度嵌入開發者工作流程的商業 AI 平台。
articles.summary_en: Anthropic closed a new financing round at a $965 billion valuation, surpassing OpenAI as the world's most valuable AI company, and confidentially filed for an IPO with the SEC with no timeline announced. The valuation surge is driven primarily by Claude Code's dominance in AI coding, marking Anthropic's transformation from a safety-focused research lab to a commercial AI platform deeply embedded in developer workflows.
articles.take_zh: 超越 OpenAI 的估值背後是 Claude Code 的商業化勝利。Anthropic 的 AI 生態影響力快速擴大，對設計師而言，理解 Claude 工具族系的發展方向愈來愈重要。
articles.take_en: The valuation story is really a Claude Code story — developer adoption at scale converting to market dominance. For designers, Anthropic's growing ecosystem means Claude-powered tools will increasingly shape the design and product workflow.

articles.title_zh: Microsoft 推出 MAI-Thinking-1：首個自建推理模型，擺脫 OpenAI 依賴
articles.title_en: Microsoft Unveils MAI-Thinking-1, Its First From-Scratch Reasoning Model
articles.summary_zh: Microsoft 在 Build 大會發布 MAI-Thinking-1，這是其首個完全自建的推理模型，採用乾淨且具商業授權的訓練資料，未使用第三方模型蒸餾。模型具備 350 億活躍參數與 256K tokens 超長上下文視窗，針對複雜多步驟推理、長文本理解及程式碼生成設計，直接對標 OpenAI 與 Anthropic。Microsoft 並宣布 Majorana 2 量子晶片效能較前代提升千倍，距商用量子運算又近一步。
articles.summary_en: Microsoft unveiled MAI-Thinking-1 at Build — its first reasoning model trained from scratch on clean, commercially licensed data, with no third-party distillation. It offers 35B active parameters and a 256K-token context window, designed for complex multi-step reasoning, long-context understanding, and code generation, targeting OpenAI and Anthropic directly. Microsoft also announced Majorana 2, a quantum chip 1,000× more reliable than its predecessor.
articles.take_zh: Microsoft 自建推理模型，代表 AI 競爭已從「誰的 API 最好用」演進到「誰控制訓練資料與模型底層」。這對整個 AI 工具生態的長期格局影響深遠。
articles.take_en: Microsoft owning its reasoning model shifts the AI race from API quality to model sovereignty. Long-term, this restructures the AI tooling landscape at every layer of the product stack.

articles.title_zh: AI Coding 市場爭奪戰：Microsoft、Google 挑戰 Claude Code 霸主地位
articles.title_en: Microsoft and Google Take On Anthropic and OpenAI in AI Coding
articles.summary_zh: CNBC 分析顯示，Anthropic 的 Claude Code 已在 AI 程式碼輔助市場佔據主導地位，OpenAI 緊追在後；Microsoft 在 Build 大會積極布局程式碼功能，Google 在 5 月開發者大會強調相關新品，兩者皆試圖搶回份額。AI Coding 工具鏈已成為科技巨頭的新主戰場，也深刻影響產品團隊的開發工具選擇與設計師、PM 的跨職能協作模式。
articles.summary_en: CNBC reports Claude Code has taken a commanding lead in the AI coding market, with OpenAI close behind. Microsoft made coding-focused moves at Build; Google pushed coding products at its May developer conference — both chasing Anthropic. The AI coding toolchain is big tech's newest battleground, with direct implications for product team toolchains and how designers and PMs collaborate with engineering.
articles.take_zh: AI Coding 不只是工程師的事——Claude Code 的崛起代表 AI 能力正嵌入整個軟體生產流程，PM 與設計師也需要對這些工具建立基本認識，才能在 AI 原生團隊中不掉隊。
articles.take_en: AI coding tools aren't just an engineering concern. Claude Code's rise means AI is embedded in the full software production pipeline — PMs and designers who understand these tools will collaborate more effectively in AI-native product teams.
